query: I want to build something that makes the agent run the migration checks before it ever commits. Where do I start with that?

How do I check whether the agent picks this up from a realistic user request, rather than me just eyeballing the wording and hoping?
How do I prove this actually changed the agent's behavior instead of just feeling like an improvement?
I want a before/after on the same prompts — one run with it installed, one without — and some numbers I can point at.
